breakdown.description: When a specimen is weighed while immersed, buoyancy reduces the apparent weight, so the immersed mass should be smaller than the saturated-in-air mass, not larger.
breakdown.reason: The Agent did not resolve the inconsistency as demonstrated by the ground truth. The ground truth corrected the physically impossible value for the immersed mass (changing 13.6 g to 8.6 g) to create a valid prompt. The Agent, however, kept the incorrect value of 13.6 g and then added an explanation of why that value is physically inconsistent. This fails to correct the prompt's data as intended.
